scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics, acquisition, resource costs, and bounded current-state evidence reviewed in Batch 427.
findings: 500-Ki Saiyan-only Awoken Skill. Current Xenoverse 2 documentation states that it requires level 95 or higher, maximum Vegeta friendship, and prior Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan; Whis grants the skill despite it being usable only by Saiyans. Documented current modifiers include +35% all attack damage, 10% damage reduction, and an 18% Ki-recovery reduction/drain presentation. It also increases movement and stamina recovery according to the maintained skill reference.
